headline: Alupar Wins Transmission Project in Chile with $85M Investment
summary: Alupar secured a project in Chile totaling an estimated US$85 million in investments, with an annual permitted revenue of US$11.9 million.
why: Alupar is a major power transmission and generation company operating across Latin America, and new project wins expand its future cash flow base.

impacts.name: Alupar Investimento
impacts.why: Winning a major infrastructure project expands the company's asset base and permitted revenues.
